title: Junior Business Analyst
text: Junior Business Analyst at Orange Hire (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Orange Hire is a reputable plant hire company providing traffic equipment and plant to the civil construction industry. We hire multiple solutions for site perimeter, ground equipment, plant rental and safety products to make life easier for the Civil Contractor. We are currently seeking an IT Business Analyst to join our Support Office in the ERP Project Team. Reporting to the Operations Manager you will assist with implementing new systems and changes to meet current and future business needs. You will lead and participate in multidisciplinary Work Groups to scope, analyse and design required changes. You will be hands-on with testing, training and roll out, aiming to minimise productivity impacts and make the transition as smooth as possible for End Users. We recently implemented MCS rental software replacing legacy systems. About the role The successful Business Analyst will work across the full PDLC - you will operate in both a Technical and Business mindset. The successful candidate can expect to be heavily involved with MCS rental software. MUST HAVE demonstrated experience implementing ERP solutions, preferably MCS Scoping and Project stream task identification and coordination Provide input, recommendations and critique for solution design Modelling of current and future business processes Impact analysis and cost estimates Change management skills. Input and review of Technical Specifications Able to create functional and technical requirements documentation Change Management and Training Material Effectively communicate (verbal or written) to internal and external stakeholders including senior management, vendors and business users Analyse risks and determine mitigation strategies Work closely with Vendor to specify, prototype, test, refactor and refine modifications. Work with End Users to identify prototype gaps and validate acceptance of final modification. Plan and run UAT process with end users including briefing, task assignment, follow up and defect/issue escalation, resolution and re-testing. Access training and Vendor resources to confirm ERP capabilities, functionality and processes. Essential Skills and Experience Business-related technical and business BA experience (including functional design) within hire industry (preferred) Skilled at business requirement elicitation and elaboration, workshop facilitation and documentation through user stories/business requirements specifications Demonstrated capability in SQL Desirable Skills and Experience Hire Services Industry Experience Proven experience with process mapping current/future state operational environments Facilitation and/or execution of Application Testing Job benefits and perks Quarterly Bonus as part of Company Wide Profit Share Scheme Onsite carpark As part of our recruitment process successful candidates will participate in a pre-employment medical and police check.
